guard: the console attaches through the CLI attach loop in place: the seat gets the keyboard, Ctrl-] returns and repaints
why: The suite drives bin/cotal.ts, which imports @cotal-ai/cli from dist: a mutation must be built to be seen, and the tree must be rebuilt after the restore or dist keeps the mutant.

The detach pressed here lands during a live session, so the compare under test is the session reader's (attach-client.ts); the between-sessions watcher in agents.ts carries the same normalisation but is reached only while a reconnect is in flight, which this suite does not stage.
Each mutation is compile-clean and unique in the named file.

mutations.name: A1 compare the detach key on the raw stream
mutations.expectRed: detach: the console re-enters its alternate screen
mutations.cell: detach: the console re-enters its alternate screen
mutations.note: Under the console Ink has set a utf8 encoding on stdin, so the one-byte detach arrives as a string and never matches a number; Ctrl-] forwards to the child and the key goes dead for the session.

mutations.name: A2 come back without re-entering the alternate screen
mutations.expectRed: detach: the console re-enters its alternate screen
mutations.cell: detach: the console re-enters its alternate screen
mutations.note: The attach loop leaves the terminal in the main buffer; a console that does not re-enter its own screen repaints over the seat's scrollback.
